## Remote menu navigation

- Remove the short-lived authorization requirement that could reject legitimate menu focus.
- Remove the content focus-group exit override introduced after the working 0.1.89 navigation behavior.
- Keep only a short recovery window for unintended menu focus immediately after pressing OK on a content action. Directional keys, Back and explicit menu requests immediately cancel recovery; delayed recovery cannot steal focus from a subsequent menu request.
- Retain the Continue Watching episode and resume-state corrections from 0.1.92.

Signed 32-bit build. Physical-TV navigation validation remains required.
